source.title: Constraints on Neutrino Physics from DESI DR2 BAO and DR1 Full Shape
source.note: the corpus already cited this paper at FOR_60.md:133; what was missing was which table, which combination and which prior

the_64_2_meV.data: DESI DR2 BAO + the baseline 'CMB' dataset
the_64_2_meV.origin: described in the companion paper, reference [73] of 2503.14744

the_minus_0_101_eV.statistic: CENTRAL VALUE with an asymmetric interval
the_minus_0_101_eV.model: LCDM + Sum m_nu,eff -- an EXTENSION with an effective parameter
the_minus_0_101_eV.prior: uniform, ALLOWING NEGATIVE energy densities, chosen to remove prior-weight effects
the_minus_0_101_eV.data: DESI DR2 BAO + the baseline 'CMB' dataset
the_minus_0_101_eV.variant: the 'plik' row of Table 5 gives -0.099 instead, so the CMB likelihood choice moves it by 0.002 eV

the_baseline_CMB_dataset.note: this is NOT plik_lite, NOT a tau prior standing in for low-ell E, and NOT the nine Planck 2018 conservative lensing bandpowers

findings: THE TWO FIGURES ARE NOT TWO PROPERTIES OF ONE FIT. 64.2 meV is a 95 per cent upper limit under a Sum m_nu > 0 prior; -0.101 eV is a 68 per cent CENTRAL VALUE in a DIFFERENT model whose prior permits negative values. No single control can land near both at once, yet the control criterion carried through several revisions asks for exactly that.

THE PUBLISHED COMBINATION IS NOT THE ONE EITHER INSTRUMENT SCORES. The baseline CMB is high-ell CamSpec, low-ell SimAll and Commander, and Planck PR4 + ACT lensing reconstruction. 60's harness and this seat's reference both score binned plik_lite with a tau prior and the nine Planck 2018 CONSERVATIVE bandpowers, so both differ from the published combination in the likelihood itself and not only in the bin count.

A NUMERAL TRAP: 0.101 eV appears TWICE in the same paper with different meanings -- as the magnitude of the effective mass central value, and as 'Sum m_nu < 0.101 eV (95 per cent, NO)', the normal-ordering upper limit.
FOR CONTEXT, the same paper's Feldman-Cousins 95 per cent limit is 0.053 eV, and in w0waCDM the limit relaxes to 0.163 eV.
